items.summary: Refine utterance pause handling and index notification timing
items.fullMessage:
Refine utterance pause handling and index notification timing

- Rate-adaptive pause shortening and utterance-end silence: Introduce effective_chrome_rate and keep_silence_ms_for_rate in speech_processing to scale silence duration dynamically by speech rate and pause mode. Refine _iter_speech_chunks in synth driver to track trailing commands, detect pause punctuation at utterance end, and insert proper sentence and end-of-utterance pauses.
- Index notification timing and pause resilience: Defer synth index notifications while speech playback is paused, flushing them safely upon resume or segment completion. Sync wave player only when paused to prevent playback stutter while maintaining prompt cancellation checks.

items.summary: Fix --loglevel typo in CLI help and user guide (#20967)
items.fullMessage:
Fix --loglevel typo in CLI help and user guide (#20967)

Summary of the issue:

The --debug-logging and --no-logging help text in source/argsParsing.py and the corresponding user guide rows refer to --loglevel (missing hyphen). The actual option is --log-level, so users copying the documented name get an unrecognized-argument error.
Description of user facing changes:

Four one-word corrections, no behavior change:

    source/argsParsing.py: --debug-logging and --no-logging help strings now say --log-level.
    user_docs/en/userGuide.md: the --debug-logging and --no-logging rows now say --log-level.

Description of developer facing changes:

None.
Description of development approach:

Mechanical string replacement, verified zero remaining --loglevel occurrences in both files.
Testing strategy:

    ruff check source/argsParsing.py: clean.
    markdownlint-cli2 user_docs/en/userGuide.md: no findings.
    Full unit suite on Windows (rununittests.bat): 1468 tests, 0 failures (3 pre-existing environmental magnification errors, unchanged from baseline).
